outline: 1.積體電路的分類，2.積體電路晶片設計的流程，3.CMOS元件的基本結構與佈局，4.CMOS元件的設計規範技術，5.CMOS元件組成各種數位電路，6.以高階方法探討積體電路之設計，7.系統分割，8.設計問題之探討，9.IC的構造， 10.設計方法，11.時序問題之探討，12.鐘脈問題之探討，13.VLSI之測試，14.有助於設計與測試的結構化技巧探討，15.專題製作。
schedule:
Week 1 (22/2): Brief of Semiconductor Manufacturing Process
Week 2 (1/3): Brief of IC wafer fabrication techniques, MOS Transistor
Week 3 (8/3): MOS Transistor, CMOS Logic (part I)
Week 4 (15/3): CMOS logic gates (part II)
Week 5 (22/3): Sequential circuits (part III)
Week 6 (29/3): CMOS Fabrication and Layout, Stick diagrams
Week 7 (5/4): National holiday
Week 8 (12/4): Test 1; Device Characteristics: non-ideal effects, DC transfer characteristics (part I)
Week 9 (19/4): Midterm Examination
Week 10 (26/4): Device Characteristics: non-ideal effects, DC transfer characteristics (part II)
Week 11 (3/5): Transient response, RC delay model: effective resistance, gate and diffusion capacitance, equivalent RC circuits (part I)
Week 12 (10/5): Elmore delay, linear delay model: logical effort, parasitic delay, logical effort paths (part II)
Week 13 (17/5): Logical effort paths (part III)
Week 14 (24/5): Wires: Interconnect modeling, delay, crosstalk,
Week 15 (31/5): Process variation, latch-up
Week 16 (7/6): Manufacturing test principles
Week 17 (14/6): Test 2; review
Week 18 (21/6): Final Examination
assessment:
期中考:30%
期末考:30%
平時考+平時表現:40%
